node.statement: Matrix identification: by the definitions of matrix multiplication, the amplification (Ha^Q_{P,R})_n, and the amplified sesquilinear form carried by def-hcb-datum, the three sums in the preceding equality are respectively (Y^dagger dot Z) dot X, Y^dagger dot (Z dot X), and <Y,(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X>. The compressed products and dagger are well typed at amplification level by lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Substitution proves the exact amplified Ha equation.
